description: This file defines a base class for membership table tests within the Orleans distributed cluster framework. It includes methods for testing membership table operations such as insert, read, update, and cleanup, with utilities for creating test entries and managing test lifecycle. It also contains constants related to silo statuses and configurations used across membership tests.

classes.name: SiloInstanceTableTestConstants
classes.description: Defines constants related to silo status and test configurations, such as timeouts and status strings.

classes.name: MembershipTableTestsBase
classes.description: An abstract base class providing a framework for testing Orleans membership table implementations. It includes setup, teardown, and various test utility methods for inserting, reading, updating, and cleaning up membership entries.

methods.name: CreateGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Abstract factory method to create a gateway list provider.

methods.name: CreateMembershipTable
methods.description: Abstract factory method to create a membership table.

methods.name: GetConnectionString
methods.description: Abstract method to asynchronously retrieve the database connection string.

methods.name: MembershipTable_GetGateways
methods.description: Test method for verifying gateway retrieval and membership insertion.

methods.name: MembershipTable_ReadAll_EmptyTable
methods.description: Test method for reading an empty membership table.

methods.name: MembershipTable_InsertRow
methods.description: Test method for inserting a membership row into the table.

methods.name: MembershipTable_ReadRow_Insert_Read
methods.description: Test method for inserting and reading back a membership entry.

methods.name: MembershipTable_ReadAll_Insert_ReadAll
methods.description: Test method for inserting a membership entry and verifying through reading all entries.

methods.name: MembershipTable_UpdateRow
methods.description: Test method for updating a membership entry and verifying the update.

methods.name: MembershipTable_UpdateRowInParallel
methods.description: Test method for performing concurrent updates on a membership row.

methods.name: MembershipTable_UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Test method for updating the IAmAlive timestamp for a membership entry.

methods.name: MembershipTable_CleanupDefunctSiloEntries
methods.description: Test method for cleaning up defunct (dead or expired) silo entries.

methods.name: CreateMembershipEntryForTest
methods.description: Utility method to create a test membership entry.

methods.name: GetUtcNowWithSecondsResolution
methods.description: Utility method returning the current UTC time truncated to seconds precision.

methods.name: CreateSiloAddressForTest
methods.description: Utility method to create a test silo address with incrementing ID.
